Instructions for Use
Device description: The Helix Coronary Stent System is a coronary stent. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Helix Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Helix Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Helix Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 25 T/m (2,500 G/cm)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 4 W/kg
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
